description: Passive security hygiene. Reads response headers and the page as delivered; sends nothing a visitor would not send. No probing, no payloads. Review of the project's own source is a separate local script.

checks.title: Page is served over HTTPS
checks.recommendation: Serve the page over HTTPS only and redirect HTTP to it.

checks.title: HSTS header is present
checks.recommendation: Send Strict-Transport-Security so browsers stay on HTTPS.

checks.title: Content-Security-Policy is present
checks.recommendation: Send a Content-Security-Policy that limits where scripts can load from.

checks.title: Page cannot be framed by other sites
checks.recommendation: Send frame-ancestors in CSP or X-Frame-Options.

checks.title: Referrer policy is set
checks.recommendation: Send a Referrer-Policy such as strict-origin-when-cross-origin.

checks.title: No mixed content
checks.recommendation: Load every script, style, image and frame over HTTPS.

checks.title: Third-party scripts use integrity hashes
checks.recommendation: Add integrity attributes to third-party scripts you pin, or host them yourself.

checks.title: External new-tab links are protected
checks.recommendation: Add rel="noopener" to external links that open a new tab.

checks.title: Forms do not post over HTTP
checks.recommendation: Point every form action at an HTTPS address.
